# Security Policy

Please report security issues privately. Do **not** open a public GitHub issue for a security issue.

- Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/sandialabs/PEAT/security/advisories/new) ("Report a vulnerability" on the Security tab).
- Or email the PEAT development team at `peat AT sandia DOT gov`.

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

The full policy, including supported versions, how we respond to reports, and how reporters are credited, is in [SECURITY.rst](../SECURITY.rst).
